description: A security by ISIN, CUSIP or ticker (with an optional exchange code): its OpenFIGI id, name, ticker, exchange, security type and market sector, and for an ISIN the issuer's LEI and legal name from GLEIF. ISIN and CUSIP check digits are verified before the call. Attribution: FIGI by OpenFIGI; LEI by GLEIF. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

exchange.description: Optional OpenFIGI exchange code, e.g. US or LN
